dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, rapid 2D geometric narrowing initiated from the mid-back region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse yellowish-grey patches visible on the left lateral-dorsal region and posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the faint pigmented regions and the primary white baseline.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharply defined longitudinal dorsal ridge and a high-contrast circular blowhole.
